我的生活与旅行(My Life and travel): 一篇关于旅行出行的A2短文:本与利奥的经历和小计划。
It takes twenty minutes to get to the bus stop by bike. Ben wrote about the day in the diary. Ben and Leo had great fun there. In fact, all rooms are en suite here.
The bus stop is one of the best places in the city. Ben thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. Ben plays chess with Leo every Tuesday. Best of all, cars are fined in the bus lane.
Last Tuesday, Ben and Leo went to the bus stop. Ben is reading a book about science. The weather was windy that day. Queue at the bag drop first.
There are always many people at the airport. Ben learned a lot about science. Ben usually has fish for breakfast.
